I hardened the app in a few key ways:

- Added secure cookie handling for auth tokens
- Removed the unsafe fallback JWT secret; the app now requires `JWT_SECRET`
- Added basic security headers
- Added request body size limits
- Added CSRF protection for state-changing requests
- Moved the frontend to use httpOnly auth cookies instead of storing JWTs in `localStorage`
- Updated auth and cart flows to send credentials with requests
- Strengthened password policy for registration
- Enabled production-only secure cookie settings

A note: the repo’s lint script can’t run in this container because `tsc` isn’t installed here, so I couldn’t verify types end-to-end. If you want, I can also do a second pass for input validation and authorization tightening across all routes.
